addr.name: gameStateBase

addr.desc: Game state struct base. Pointer to it lives at gameStatePtr.

addr.name: gameStatePtr
addr.evidence: field_module init: lw a0,-0x5c64(0x8006xxxx) then lhu v0,0x1930(a0) (fieldVars)
addr.desc: Kernel global holding the gameState base pointer.

addr.name: fieldID
addr.evidence: boot dispatcher READ 0x8001b7a8: (fieldID&0x7FF)<0x400 -> module 1 Field else module 3 Worldmap; WRITE 0x8001b7ec sets 490 (title screen)
addr.desc: gameState+0x231A. Current field/map ID. >=0x400 selects worldmap module.

addr.name: gold
addr.evidence: FUN_8001c1a8 (native debug menu): DAT_8006ef58 = 999999999
addr.desc: gameState+0x1924. Money.

addr.name: fieldVars
addr.evidence: field-module init copies 512 u16 from gameState+0x1930 to local mirror 0x800C3A68
addr.desc: gameState+0x1930. 512 script variables; var[0]=GameProgress, var[2]=field entry point (see flags.xml).

addr.name: partyMemberBitField
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384 (battle module): read as mask together with partyFrameMask
addr.desc: gameState+0x1D30. Bitmask of unlocked party members.

addr.name: partyFrameMask
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: ANDed with partyMemberBitField
addr.desc: gameState+0x1D32. Second party availability mask.

addr.name: kernelPartySlots
addr.evidence: kernel sync 0x800A3200 copies these u32s (low byte) into currentParty every frame; live write of slot0=2 persisted and gameState+vars followed
addr.desc: MASTER party representation (field kernel BSS). Low byte = char id, 0xFF = empty. Write HERE, not currentParty.

addr.name: currentParty
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: iterates 0x8006F368..0x8006F36A, value&0x7F; live: per-frame copy of kernelPartySlots (writes reverted)
addr.desc: gameState+0x1D34. Active party character IDs (see characters.xml), 0xFF=empty. READ-ONLY mirror of kernelPartySlots — direct writes are reverted by the kernel sync.

addr.name: partyRoster
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: memcpy(0xA4) from charId*0xA4+0x8006D8A0 per party member
addr.desc: gameState+0x26C. 11 character records of 0xA4 bytes (stats/level/equipment).

addr.name: gearRoster
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: gearId*0xA4+0x8006DFAC
addr.desc: gameState+0x978. 20 gear records of 0xA4 bytes.

addr.name: battleEntities
addr.evidence: battle setup FUN_801e5384: destination buffer filled per party member, stride 0x170
addr.desc: Battle entity slots (11 x 0x170 bytes), battle module BSS.

addr.name: battleModuleOverlay

addr.desc: Battle module load region (informational, not a writable variable).

addr.name: actorArrayPtr

addr.name: developmentModeWord
addr.evidence: SLUS FieldMain tests the word against -1, then loads file 0xAD to 0x80280000 when development mode is active
addr.desc: Retail is 0xFFFFFFFF. Zero enables the Field/Battle development paths and requires the runtime's 8 MiB developer RAM profile.

addr.name: nativeDebugMenuEnable
addr.evidence: FUN_8001c1a8 gates the Menu=(%d)%s debug menu list on DAT_80059178 != 0
addr.desc: Nonzero enables the debug selector inside module 5 MenuMain. This is not the module 0 XENOGEARS Kernel MENU or the PC/HDD development-mode word.

addr.name: moduleSwitchFn
addr.evidence: jal 0x8001996c in boot dispatcher; a0=module id (1=Field,2=Battle,3=Worldmap,4=Battling,5=Menu,6=Movie)
addr.desc: ChangeGameState(unsigned state); state 0 selects the native Kernel Menu through MainLoop.

addr.name: mainLoopFn
addr.evidence: MainLoop dispatches g_MainGameStates[state].pFnMain; the state-0 table entry at 0x8001808C points to KernelMenuMain
addr.desc: MainLoop(int errorCode); the developer-mode action resumes here with state 0 after leaving the interrupted module.

addr.name: kernelMenuMainFn
addr.evidence: KernelMenuMain and the SLUS table pointer at 0x8001808C
addr.desc: Native XENOGEARS Kernel MENU main function.

addr.name: fieldMapNumber
addr.evidence: poll 0x800784E4 masks (id&0xFFF)*2 as bundle file index; 0x98 path writes it (field_module.exe 0x800933AC); confirmed: intro writer sw 4; gear-state reads &0xFFF
addr.desc: TELEPORT TARGET. The map-change request channel.

addr.name: activeFieldVars
addr.evidence: FUN_800a3018/800a3074 read/write DAT_800c3a68; init 0x800705DC copies persistent gameState+0x1930 (512 u16) in, zeroes scratch 512; persist 0x800A30FC copies 512 back out
addr.desc: TELEPORT ENTRY (active mirror). Write entry point to +2 (var[1]); handlers read this copy, persist clobbers a persistent-only write.

addr.name: overlaySignature
addr.evidence: field/world/battle/battling overlays all load at 0x8006FAF0 (header_size=0); first word 4=Field 5=Worldmap 6=Battle — same ground truth as the renderer's semantic-module detection in main.cpp, confirmed live across sustained sessions
addr.desc: TELEPORT GUARD. Field module resident iff first word == 4.

addr.name: residentLoadedModule
addr.evidence: SLUS FUN_800199CC sets it to the loaded overlay id on every module load (-1 while loading); BUT it belongs to the developer debug menu state machine and reads a constant 0xFFFFFFFF during normal retail play in this runtime — NOT a usable teleport guard, kept for documentation only
addr.desc: DEV-MENU ONLY. Do not use as a module signal; use overlaySignature.

addr.name: teleportGate1
addr.evidence: poll gate at 0x80078498: must be 0; init 0x800705DC sets 0xFFFFFFFF; 0x98 path + door path clear it (sw zero) as the commit; the door handler clears it (sw zero,-9236(0x800B))
addr.desc: RECIPE: write 0 LAST (commit). Poll consumes target+entry together.

addr.name: partyLoadState
addr.evidence: field party staging: loading char 0x800ADBC8, dest slot 0x800ADBCC, temp alloc 0x800ADBC0, load state 0x800ADBC4 with 0xFF idle (init 0x800705DC); NOT a teleport arm — read-only busy check (refuse while != 0xFF)
addr.desc: BUSY CHECK (read-only): refuse teleport while != 0xFF (party streaming).

addr.name: menuRequest
addr.evidence: menu opcodes write it (FE 58 writes 3 at 0x80093824); consumed/reset to 0xFF by FieldLoadAndOpenMenu 0x800799D4 (writes at 0x8007A404); idle is 0xFF (init 0x800705DC)
addr.desc: BUSY CHECK (read-only): refuse teleport while != 0xFF (menu staged). NEVER write 0 (queues bogus menu mode 0).

addr.name: fadeGate
addr.evidence: poll gate at 0x80078518: halfword must be 0; written by fade/transition impls 0x80071DCC/0x80071E58/0x8007DA44
addr.desc: BUSY CHECK (read-only): refuse teleport while != 0 (fade/transition running).

addr.name: teleportGateAnim
addr.evidence: poll gate at 0x800784D0: must be 0 (usually already 0)
addr.desc: READ-ONLY: never write (poll retries it); zeroing while busy fakes readiness.
